before: The wash-sale disallowance exceeds this sale's own loss once its basis is corrected.
after: The wash-sale loss disallowed is more than this sale's own loss once its basis is corrected (the corrected basis minus its proceeds, or zero if it is not a loss); check the wash-sale amount against the proceeds, the corrected basis, and column (g).

before: The correct basis equals the basis the Form 1099-B shows, so there is nothing to correct. Record the sale as a sale with no adjustment (or with code W only).
after: The corrected basis equals the basis shown on Form 1099-B, so no code B basis correction applies; record the sale without a basis correction (or with code W only if it has a wash-sale loss disallowed).

before: A wash-sale disallowance is recorded on a sale that is not a loss once its basis is corrected.
after: A wash-sale loss disallowed was entered on a sale that is not a loss once its basis is corrected (proceeds are at least corrected basis); a wash sale only disallows a loss, so check the wash-sale amount and the corrected basis.

before: The holding period does not match this short-term or long-term family.
after: This sale is marked long-term but was entered with short-term sales, or marked short-term but entered with long-term sales; check the dates you acquired and sold it (more than 1 year is long-term) and, if you have a Form 1099-B, whether its box 2 shows short-term or long-term.

before: The wash-sale disallowed amount exceeds this transaction's own otherwise-deductible loss, floor_zero(basis - proceeds). Existing block code: tax.us.2025.block.f8949.adjustment-exceeds-loss.
after: The wash-sale loss disallowed in box 1g of this Form 1099-B is more than this sale's loss (its basis minus its proceeds, or zero if it is not a loss); check the box 1g amount against the proceeds in box 1d and the cost or other basis in box 1e.

before: A disallowed amount is contributed without an affirmative wash-sale adjustment flag. Independently blockable. Existing block code: tax.us.2025.block.f8949.box-1g-amount-without-flag.
after: A box 1g wash-sale disallowed amount was entered on this Form 1099-B sale without marking that box 1g applies; confirm whether box 1g shows a wash-sale loss disallowed, or remove the disallowed amount.

before: The wash-sale adjustment flag is affirmative but no disallowed amount is contributed. The two fields are independently contributable (ADR-0061 Decision 1), so this state is representable and must be independently blockable. Existing block code: tax.us.2025.block.f8949.box-1g-flag-without-amount.
after: This Form 1099-B sale is marked as having a box 1g wash-sale loss disallowed, but no disallowed amount was entered; enter the wash-sale loss disallowed from box 1g (or 0 if none), or unmark the box 1g wash-sale indicator.

before: A positive wash-sale disallowed amount is asserted on a transaction whose proceeds are greater than or equal to its basis (code W on an individually non-loss transaction). Evaluated on this member's own proceeds and basis, never on a netted box subtotal. Existing block code: tax.us.2025.block.f8949.code-w-on-gain.
after: A wash-sale loss disallowed in box 1g of this Form 1099-B was entered on a sale that is not a loss (proceeds are at least basis); a wash sale only disallows a loss, so enter 0 in column (g) if no part of the loss is a nondeductible wash sale, or check box 1d and box 1e.

before: The wash-sale disallowance exceeds this sale's own loss.
after: The wash-sale loss disallowed is more than this sale's own loss (its basis minus its proceeds, or zero if it is not a loss); check the disallowed wash-sale amount against the proceeds and the cost or other basis.

before: A sale whose basis was reported to the IRS is not a member of this family.
after: This sale's Form 1099-B shows that its cost or other basis was reported to the IRS, so it belongs with covered sales (Schedule D line 1a or 8a, or Form 8949 box A or D if adjusted), not with sales whose basis was not reported to the IRS.

before: A wash-sale disallowance is recorded on a sale that is not a loss.
after: A wash-sale loss disallowed was entered on a sale that is not a loss (proceeds are at least basis); a wash sale only disallows a loss, so enter 0 if no part of the loss is a nondeductible wash sale, or check proceeds and basis.

before: The wash-sale disallowance exceeds this sale's own loss.
after: The wash-sale loss disallowed is more than this sale's own loss (its basis minus its net proceeds, or zero if it is not a loss); check the disallowed wash-sale amount against the net proceeds and the cost or other basis.

before: A wash-sale disallowance is recorded on a sale that is not a loss.
after: A wash-sale loss disallowed was entered on a sale that is not a loss (net proceeds are at least basis); a wash sale only disallows a loss, so enter 0 if no part of the loss is a nondeductible wash sale, or check net proceeds and basis.
